stop_reason: No exercise contrast is identifiable. All 12 sequenced myobundles received exercise-like E-Stim (Table 1; GEO treatment field '( EStim)' on every sample); there is no unstimulated or pre-stimulation arm. The data support only tomatidine vs vehicle under E-Stim (a drug effect) and YA vs OS (donor age/activity, one donor source per cohort, aliased with donor), neither of which is an effect of exercise.
